hooks.command: h=''; t=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); c=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); for d in "$t" "${c%/.git}" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; do if [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/.claude/hooks/prepushVerify.sh" ]; then h="$d/.claude/hooks/prepushVerify.sh"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$h" ]; then echo '[prepushVerify] BLOCK: フック本体が見つからない（cwd のリポジトリ・main worktree・CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR のどこにも無い）。未検証は合格にしない。' >&2; exit 2; fi; bash "$h" || exit 2
